## Appearance

Gilbert Blythe is a tall, manly fellow with broad shoulders, curly brown hair, and roguish, straightforward hazel eyes. He often wears a teasing smile on his frank face. Following a period away, he was noted to appear notably pale and thin.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 ch.Weddings P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022)_

## Personality

Gilbert Blythe is a clever and popular young man who approaches life with high spirits, ambition, and zest. Known for his good-natured attitude toward rivalries, he demonstrates academic excellence, having led his class while studying. Driven by a determination to get the best out of life and put the best into it, he aims to earn his own way through college, earn a First Class teacher's license in one year, and complete his medical course to fight disease, pain, and ignorance. His aspirations also include winning High Honors and the Cooper Prize, as well as marrying [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## History

Gilbert Blythe grew up in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where he once taunted [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at school, resulting in her smashing a slate over his head and spurning his apologies. During their school years, he entered into a fierce academic rivalry with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), though he saved her life on the pond when her boat sank. The two tied academically for their [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams, with Gilbert winning the school medal, but he generously relinquished the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) teaching post so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could stay close to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). During their time teaching, Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reconciled into close friends and discussed school corporal punishment as well as their future plans. He later attended [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), where he led the Freshmen to victory in the annual rush, took High Honors in Classics, and won the Cooper Prize. Although [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially rejected his marriage proposal in college, Gilbert later confessed his enduring love for her in Hester Gray's garden, and she accepted. After their wedding in the orchard at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Gilbert moved with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) to begin his medical career. Following the tragic loss of their firstborn child, Joyce, Gilbert insisted that his colleague tell [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) about a potential brain operation for her husband, which led to the revelation that the man was actually Leslie's cousin. After taking over his great-uncle's medical practice at [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Mary](../character/mary-joe.md), Gilbert welcomed a healthy baby boy, [James Matthew](../character/james-matthew.md), with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Following the death of their friend Captain Jim, Gilbert proposed purchasing the [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) to better accommodate their growing family.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> “All right!” Gilbert sprang into his skiff with an angry color in his cheeks. “I’ll never ask you to be friends again, Anne Shirley. And I don’t care either!”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)

> “Not she,” said Gilbert emphatically. “I know Louisa Spencer well. She doesn’t ‘believe’ in Village Improvement Societies, but she does believe in dollars and cents. She’d be more likely to urge Judson on than to dissuade him.”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P46](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0046)

> "and I’ve given that up in despair. Levi won’t have it taken down just to vex us. There’s a contrary streak in all the Boulters and it’s strongly developed in him."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P57](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0057)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert's relationship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins as a childhood schoolmate and fierce academic rival, sparked when he taunts her and she smashes her slate over his head [R1, R2, S1]. Although she initially refuses his apologies and offers of friendship—even after he rescues her from a sinking boat—they eventually reconcile to become best friends, study partners, and eventually husband and wife [R1, R3, R4, R5, S4, S12]. Over the years, Gilbert harbours romantic feelings for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), eventually marrying her in an orchard ceremony at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) before starting their new life together [R3, R5, S12].

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share a long-standing academic rivalry throughout their school years as they compete to be first in their class [R6, S7]. After winning scholastic honors together, they grow closer, sharing quiet romantic moments and evening walks as their lives progress [S8, S10, S11]. Their relationship culminates in their marriage in the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) orchard, after which they depart together to begin their new life in [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Mary](../character/mary-joe.md) [S12].
